gold_rationale: Clause 65(8) requires CKYCR updates within 7 days of receiving updated information (at_most 7). The program (byte-identical to the pre-2024 candidate) has no day-count or date field and no 7-day deadline check anywhere in its reachable logic.

regulation_clause.text: ABSENCE (old side is the absence of any update-deadline): clause (h) required uploading/updating KYC data at periodic updation or when updated information was received, with NO time-bound deadline. The seven-day sentence carries footnote 148: 'Inserted vide circular DOR.AML.REC.49/14.01.001/2024-25 dated November 6, 2024' - 'Inserted', not 'Amended': the sentence had no predecessor in any form.

gold_rationale: The pre-2024-11-06 clause (h) requires uploading/updating KYC data at periodic updation or on receipt of updated information, with NO time-bound deadline. T6KYC05 only constructs an audit-log message (lines 16-19) with no deadline concept. There is no elapsed-time or deadline gate anywhere in the program, consistent with an obligation that has no deadline to violate.
